subject: COLD START: the first 1-2 deliverFlag calls after an idle period return null, so the first student to finish a box sees Token: N/A. Reproduced on os002 post-deploy: scenarios 1-2 null, 3-5 fine, then 1-2 fine on retry. requestFlagText should retry once before rendering N/A
description: [2026-09-17 21:37] MEASURED 2026-09-17, mechanism in this task's title is CONTRADICTED — do not build the retry as written. deliverFlag production logs show 5 invocations (one per os003 scenario) ALL with auth VALID and NO errors; scenario 1 sat behind a container cold start (21:03:26.875 'Starting new instance' -> 21:03:29.059 STARTUP TCP probe -> request verified 21:03:29.297). _tools/hexos/flag-slot-fill-latency.probe.js played scenario 1 four times on hexworth.com polling to 30s: a real flag{os003_missing_vcredist_fixed} EVERY time, 'Token: N/A' NEVER written, present in both innerText and textContent, ~1.0s warm. So the first call did not RETURN null, it returned LATE, and the observed 'Token: N/A' came from a harness reading once after a fixed sleep(1600) -- not from requestFlagText resolving null. NOTE the trap: the [ARENA] 'Cannot deliver flag - no auth or registryId' warning DOES appear on successful plays; that is the BoxEngine.js:103 prefetch firing pre-engagement, by design per task 372, NOT the scenario's delivery. What remains genuinely open and UNMEASURED: whether a real null-resolving path exists (BoxEngine.js:1487 early return and :1502 catch both return null with no retry, and os003 config.js:1033 writes N/A one-shot with no .catch and nothing re-rendering, so N/A WOULD stick). Flags are verified server-side by validateFlag, so the rendered token is display only -- this is cosmetic, and a retry in BoxEngine.js is loaded by 95 boxes. Measure a true cold fill before building anything here. Real fix shipped instead: the gate that mis-reported (os003-completability.test.js:95 fixed-sleep sample, :97 accepting 'Token: loading...').
